resources.string: Wide draws Aerial\'s tile art from the app\'s TV banner, four to six a row. Square shows the app\'s own Android icon, five to eight a row.

Files and names every app on this TV by the list — the TV\'s own file first, then the cloud copy, then the built-in one; a name typed on the phone still wins. Tiles you move afterwards stay where you moved them.
%1$d apps filed into preset folders, %2$d named from the list

The TV\'s own music volume, not one app\'s: Home lifts it to full as it comes up. Keeping it held answers the remote\'s volume keys and another app\'s slider straight back, for as long as Home runs. Where the level is set past this box — HDMI-CEC, a soundbar — there is nothing here to move, and the log says so.
Ask again to confirm: press Reboot the TV once more within a few seconds
This TV would not let Home reboot it: it needs a system grant or root

Shows the notice from superaerialnotice.txt in the middle of the screen when Home starts: the TV\'s own file first, then the copy at the address on the TV, then our site, then the one built in. Its buttons are a confirmation counting down from ten and one that turns this switch off. A notice nobody on this TV has read yet is announced whatever this switch says.
